frame-arabic.note: No Arabic in any of the 20 frames.

frame-hidden.note: No recordings: every frame is drawn by the kit.

frame-google.note: Google appears only as plain words (the Published line, the end card line, the small print); no Google logo or colours.

frame-proof.note: The only review shown is the Example business's demo text: no stars, no name, no count, and it is not shown as a Kabsi testimonial.

frame-people.note: No people or faces in any frame.

frame-example.note: The Example badge is in the chat header on every frame from 0.0 to 6.5 s, as long as the Example business is on screen.

frame-yes.note: The Yes button (3.5 to 5.0 s), its tap and the owner's Yes bubble (from 5.5 s) are shown.

safe-zone.note: All text sits inside the safe area on the contact sheet, and on a safe-zone debug still at 5.7 s.

captions-clear.note: Captions sit low in the empty part of the screen, about 300 px below the Yes button and its tap.

tap-rings.note: One soft dark ring over the Yes button at 4.9 to 5.4 s, visible on the yellow button.

end-card.note: The line, the call to action and the small print show from 7.5 s to the end, but the mark is the dashed stand-in ring: the logo files are not uploaded yet.

hook.note: The review and the caption "A new review came in." are on screen by 0.5 s.

sound-off.note: Captions carry every spoken line and the chat shows the story.
